builds.name: Reference: Mana burst
builds.goal: Reference for LeBlanc: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile burst mage who links a marked spell sequence and returns through Distortion to limit retaliation. Chains reward maintaining a tether long enough for delayed control. Compare mark detonation and return-safe spell burst with real attacks between casts. Chains must remain connected; returning through W can end the damage window. AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for LeBlanc: Compare mark detonation and return-safe spell burst with real attacks between casts. Chains must remain connected; returning through W can end the damage window.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

kitEvidence.formula:
LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit, dealing [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and granting True Sight.

If they remain shackled for [1.5] seconds, LeBlanc Roots them for [1.5] seconds and deals an additional [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.85) × AP] magic damage.

LeBlanc projects a sigil to an enemy, dealing [65 / 90 / 115 / 140 / 165 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and marking them for [3.5] seconds.

Damaging the marked enemy with an Ability detonates the sigil, dealing [65 / 90 / 115 / 140 / 165 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds [100]% of the Mana cost and [30]% of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

The initial sigil deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=8, changes=[])] damage to minions.
When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes Invisible for 1 second and creates a harmless clone for 8 seconds. LeBlanc can move the clone with the "Alt" key.

LeBlanc dashes then deals [75 / 115 / 155 / 195 / 235 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies. For [4] seconds after dashing, LeBlanc can Recast.

Recast: LeBlanc returns to her starting location.

LeBlanc mimics her most recent Ability, using it again. The mimicked Ability deals increased damage.

Mimicked Sigil of Malice deals [70 / 150 / 230 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage when applied, and [140 / 300 / 460 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage when consumed.
Mimicked Distortion deals [150 / 315 / 480 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage.
Mimicked Ethereal Chains deals [70 / 150 / 230 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage when shackled and [140 / 300 / 460 + (0.85) × AP] magic damage when Rooting.
